gloss: to despair; to lose all hope

definitions.gloss: to despair; to lose all hope
definitions.explanation: To feel that there is no hope left, often in response to a devastating situation or repeated failure.

examples.japanese: {将来|しょうらい}に{絶望|ぜつぼう}した。
{何度|なんど}{失敗|しっぱい}しても{絶望|ぜつぼう}してはいけない。
examples.english: No matter how many times you fail, you must not lose hope.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{自分|じぶん}の{無力|むりょく}さに{絶望|ぜつぼう}して、すべてを{投|な}げ{出|だ}した。
examples.english: He despaired at his own powerlessness and threw everything away.

examples.japanese: {絶望|ぜつぼう}の{中|なか}にも{希望|きぼう}の{光|ひかり}はある。
examples.english: Even in the midst of despair, there is a ray of hope.

notes:
A strong, dramatic word. The pattern is 〜に{絶望|ぜつぼう}する (to despair at/over something). The noun {絶望|ぜつぼう} (despair) is equally common, often paired with {希望|きぼう} (hope) as its opposite.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶望|ぜつぼう}{的|てき}な: hopeless, desperate
- {絶望|ぜつぼう}{感|かん}: feeling of despair
- {絶望|ぜつぼう}の{淵|ふち}: the brink of despair
- {絶望|ぜつぼう}の{底|そこ}: the depths of despair
- {絶望|ぜつぼう}から{立|た}ち{直|なお}る: to recover from despair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {失望|しつぼう}する: to be disappointed — much milder; implies unfulfilled expectations rather than total hopelessness
- {諦|あきら}める: to give up — implies acceptance rather than emotional devastation
- {落胆|らくたん}する: to be discouraged — temporary discouragement, less extreme than despair
